title: BIGGEST PLATFORMS
subtitle: USERS - 2008 to 2026
outro:
Follow for the numbers
nobody explains.
vo: In two thousand eight, Facebook was just beginning its takeover. It crushed MySpace and ruled for a decade. Then YouTube and WhatsApp scaled to billions. Instagram exploded. And out of nowhere, TikTok rewrote how the world spends its time. By twenty twenty-six, the battle for your attention has never been fiercer. Which app wins next? Follow, for the numbers nobody explains.
